items.title: Novo Claude Fable 5.1 é mais poderoso, mais barato e tem menos restrições
items.pt:
A Anthropic lançou nesta semana o Claude Fable 5.1 e o Claude Mythos 5.1, novas versões do seu modelo mais avançado de inteligência artificial. Os dois compartilham o mesmo conjunto de pesos, mas diferem no nível de restrição aplicado às respostas.
O Fable 5.1 está disponível para qualquer usuário, enquanto o Mythos 5.1 segue restrito a organizações validadas em programas de acesso da empresa.
Segundo a Anthropic, o lançamento também reduz custos, muda o armazenamento de dados corporativos e aju

items.title: I'm a Developer in Nigeria. I Stopped Calling Myself That First.
items.pt:
I'm a Developer in Nigeria. I Stopped Calling Myself That First.


A few months ago, I searched my own name to see what the internet thought of me. Google's AI summary described me as "a Nigerian full-stack software engineer... active in the Lagos tech ecosystem."

Technically accurate. And also, I realized, quietly limiting.

Nothing about that description was wrong. But it was doing something I hadn't noticed before: framing me as local talent by default, before a single client ever looked at

items.title: Corte gigantesco: Uber demite 3,3 mil funcionários e praticamente encerra home office
items.pt:
A Uber anunciou nesta quarta-feira (2) uma reestruturação que vai cortar cerca de 3,3 mil funcionários em todo o mundo, o equivalente a aproximadamente 10% de sua força de trabalho. A mudança também reduz drasticamente a possibilidade de trabalho remoto: apenas cerca de 1% dos funcionários poderá trabalhar totalmente a distância daqui para frente.
Segundo a Reuters, a companhia tinha aproximadamente 34 mil funcionários no fim de 2025. Com os cortes, o quadro deve ficar próximo de 30 mil pessoas,

items.title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
items.pt: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state af

items.title: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
items.pt: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. items.title: Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics
items.pt: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation.
